caption: New Home Sales (year-over-year growth) (vermillion, left axis; year-over-year change, which strips out the regular spring-vs-winter selling swing since the raw Census series is not seasonally adjusted) against the SPY price (blue, right axis), 1993–2026. The 2008-09 collapse (sales led the GFC) and the 2022-23 rate-shock contraction are the vivid episodes. Shaded bands mark NBER recessions.
narrative_alignment_note: Hero shows the deseasonalised YoY signal (never the raw NSA level) with the 0% line and the housing episodes.
